test_cases.description: Verify that a task is successfully created when provided with valid TaskCreate data and user_name.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Valid Input

test_setup.given: A valid TaskCreate object with required fields and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: The task is persisted via repository.add_task, the operation is logged, and the created task or its identifier is returned.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called with the valid data.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles missing required TaskCreate fields by raising an error or returning a failure.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Missing Required Field

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object missing a required field (e.g., title) and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: An error is raised or a failure response is returned, and no task is persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles invalid data types for TaskCreate fields.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Invalid TaskCreate Data Type

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with an invalid data type for a field (e.g., title as an integer) and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: A validation error is raised or a failure response is returned, and no task is persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles missing user_name by raising an error or returning a failure.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Missing User Name

test_setup.given: A valid TaskCreate object and a missing or None user_name.
test_setup.then: An error is raised or a failure response is returned, and no task is persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles TaskCreate.title at the maximum allowed length.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Maximum Length Title

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with a title at the maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters) and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: The task is successfully created and persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles an empty string for TaskCreate.title.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Empty Title

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with an empty title ('') and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: A validation error is raised or a failure response is returned.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles repository.add_task raising an exception or failing to persist.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Repository Failure

test_setup.given: A valid TaskCreate object, a valid user_name, and repository.add_task raises an exception (e.g., database error).
test_setup.then: The exception is propagated or handled, and an error is logged or returned.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function can handle TaskCreate.title containing special or Unicode characters.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Special Characters in Title

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with special/unicode characters in the title and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: The task is created and persisted successfully with correct handling of special characters.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task can be created when only the minimum required fields are provided.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Only Required Fields

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with only required fields set and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: The task is created and persisted successfully.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that the function handles a None TaskCreate object.
test_cases.name: Create Task with Null Task Object

test_setup.given: TaskCreate object is None, and user_name is valid.
test_setup.then: An error is raised or a failure response is returned, and no task is persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify behavior when a task is created with a title that already exists (if uniqueness is enforced).
test_cases.name: Create Task with Duplicate Title

test_setup.given: A TaskCreate object with a title that already exists in the system and a valid user_name.
test_setup.then: The function returns an error or a duplicate entry response if uniqueness is enforced, otherwise, the task is created.
test_setup.when: TaskService.create_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task is added successfully with valid data and a new unique ID is assigned.
test_cases.name: Add Task Successfully

test_setup.given: An empty in-memory task list and ID counter starting at 1; valid task data (e.g., title: 'Test Task', description: 'Sample Description')
test_setup.then: A Task object is returned with ID 1, the task is appended to the list, persisted to JSON, and creation is logged
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with the valid task data

test_cases.description: Verify that sequential calls increment the ID and all tasks are persisted.
test_cases.name: Add Multiple Tasks Sequentially

test_setup.given: An in-memory task list containing 1 task with ID 1; ID counter at 2; valid new task data
test_setup.then: Two new Task objects are returned with IDs 2 and 3, both tasks are appended, persisted to JSON, and logged
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called twice with two sets of valid task data

test_cases.description: Check if the function handles empty title in task data appropriately (edge case, depending on validation rules).
test_cases.name: Add Task with Empty Title

test_setup.given: An empty in-memory task list; task data with empty title and valid description
test_setup.then: The Task object is created and persisted, or validation error is raised if title is required
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with the data

test_cases.description: Check behavior when description is missing from task data.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Missing Description

test_setup.given: Task data with only title provided, no description
test_setup.then: The Task object is created with a null or default description, or error is raised if description is required
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with the data

test_cases.description: Test input where task data fields are not of expected type (e.g., title is a number).
test_cases.name: Add Task with Invalid Data Type

test_setup.given: Task data with title: 12345 (number), description: 'Test'
test_setup.then: Error is raised (e.g., TypeError or ValidationError) and task is not persisted
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test edge case where title length is at maximum allowed size or exceeds it.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Very Large Title

test_setup.given: Task data with title: 'T.repeat(255)', description: 'Sample'
test_setup.then: Task is created and persisted if within limit; error is raised if limit exceeded
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Simulate scenario where the persistence JSON file does not exist.
test_cases.name: Add Task When JSON File is Missing

test_setup.given: JSON file for tasks is deleted or missing; valid task data
test_setup.then: Function creates a new JSON file, persists tasks, and returns created Task
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test error scenario when JSON file is read-only and cannot be written.
test_cases.name: Add Task When JSON File is Read-Only

test_setup.given: JSON file exists but has read-only permissions; valid task data
test_setup.then: Error is raised (e.g., IOError), task is not persisted, and error is logged
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test adding a task with a title that already exists in the repository.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Duplicate Title

test_setup.given: Task list contains a task with title 'Test Task'; ID counter at next value; task data with same title
test_setup.then: Task is created and persisted with new ID; repository allows duplicate titles unless otherwise specified
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test error scenario when None is passed as task data.
test_cases.name: Add Task with None as Data

test_setup.given: None is passed for task data
test_setup.then: Error is raised (e.g., TypeError or ValueError); no task is persisted
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Verify that the first task is assigned ID 1 and persists correctly.
test_cases.name: Add Task to Empty List

test_setup.given: In-memory task list is empty; ID counter at 1; valid task data
test_setup.then: Task is created with ID 1, appended, persisted, and logged
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test behavior when ID counter is at a large number (e.g., near max int).
test_cases.name: Add Task with Large ID Counter

test_setup.given: ID counter is set to 2147483647; valid task data
test_setup.then: Task is created with ID 2147483647, appended, persisted, and logged; check for overflow issues
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Simulate a scenario where task creation logging fails.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Logging Failure

test_setup.given: Valid task data; logging system is misconfigured or unavailable
test_setup.then: Task is created, persisted, but logging fails; function handles/logs error gracefully
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called

test_cases.description: Test adding task with title and description containing special characters.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Special Characters

test_setup.given: Task data with title: '☃️✨🚀', description: '特殊字符测试'
test_setup.then: Task is created, persisted with special characters intact, and logged
